nameEn: Mining of other non-ferrous metal ores
description: This class includes mining of non-ferrous metal ores, except uranium and thorium ores.
includes: mining and preparation of copper ores
mining and preparation of nickel ores
mining and preparation of aluminium (bauxite) ores
mining and preparation of precious metal ores: gold, silver, platinum
mining and preparation of lead, zinc and tin ores
mining and preparation of chromium, manganese, cobalt, molybdenum, tantalum, vanadium etc. ores
mining of ore valued for gem-stones: diamonds etc.
excludes: mining and preparation of uranium and thorium ores, see 0721
production of mattes of nickel, see 2420
